item.title: Canadian Schellenberg 'definitely' won't face death again at China retrial: lawyer
item.description: The head of the law firm representing Canadian Robert Schellenberg says their client "definitely" won't face the death penalty again after China's top court overturned the sentence and announced his retrial on drug charges.
